close_reason: changed SignatureVerifier::verify_signature return type to core::result::Result<(), SignatureError>; updated RustCryptoVerifier stub in pkix-chain-simple; added signature workspace dep to pkix-chain-simple/Cargo.toml
description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:120-126 -- SignatureVerifier::verify_signature returns pkix_path::Result<()>, meaning the verifier is responsible for constructing pkix_path::Error::SignatureInvalid { index }. But the verifier has no idea what chain index it is being called for -- only validate_path knows that. The example in the docs shows index: 0 as a placeholder, which is wrong for any cert other than the leaf. Fix: change verify_signature return type to Result<(), signature::Error> (signature crate is already a workspace dep). validate_path wraps any Err as Error::SignatureInvalid { index } using the correct loop index. The verifier's responsibility is cryptographic pass/fail only.
title: SignatureVerifier::verify_signature return type forces wrong error index
